claim_ceiling: Synthetic campaign plan only. No Luminous denoiser, event preservation result or physical qualification is claimed.

scenarios.name: Raw source reference
scenarios.conditions: Immutable acquired source and independent event/reference truth are available.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve exact bytes and establish baseline event/time/chainage outputs.

scenarios.name: Denoiser attenuates a rare low-amplitude transient
scenarios.conditions: Target transient is close to background noise and carries critical event information.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Fail if downstream detection misses the event beyond the pre-registered margin.

scenarios.name: Short transient is spread across time
scenarios.conditions: Denoising kernel introduces temporal smoothing and broadens event onset.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure onset shift and morphology; reject when event timing/location budget is exceeded.

scenarios.name: Periodic event phase is shifted
scenarios.conditions: Filter/transform changes phase or periodicity used for independent event confirmation.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject if periodicity evidence is distorted beyond frozen tolerance.

scenarios.name: Denoiser creates a trajectory-like ridge on no-event background
scenarios.conditions: Noise suppression creates a structured feature not present in reference truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Count hallucinated events/trajectories and fail the false-positive budget.

scenarios.name: Two vehicle trajectories overlap in the spatiotemporal image
scenarios.conditions: Method returns one merged trajectory or uncertain association.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve multiple hypotheses/abstain; do not invent a single continuous path.

scenarios.name: Trajectory segments fragment under low SNR
scenarios.conditions: Independent video/trajectory truth exists and segmentation labels are held out.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare segmentation/continuity metrics on the same task and split.

scenarios.name: Denoiser trained on direct burial applied to conduit coupling
scenarios.conditions: Conduit attenuation changes signal/noise profile outside training support.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose OOD/degraded state and abstain or qualify a separate profile.

scenarios.name: Spatial fading noise reduces apparent signal strength
scenarios.conditions: Fading profile and reference event traces are independently known.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare raw, fixed filter and SVD-NLM with downstream event/chainage guardrails.

scenarios.name: A traffic/event signature is partially occluded by concurrent activity
scenarios.conditions: Noisy/overlapping signal supports more than one reconstruction.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Retain alternative tracks or abstain; report coverage/uncertainty.

scenarios.name: Slow background trend contaminates high-frequency event content
scenarios.conditions: Signal contains separable low/high frequency components and independent truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare wavelet frequency decoupling with D0/D1 using downstream event preservation.

scenarios.name: Filter creates ringing around a sharp event
scenarios.conditions: Processing introduces oscillations that resemble repeated impulses.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject if false event candidates or periodicity are introduced.

scenarios.name: Spatial channels shift during processing
scenarios.conditions: Denoiser/downsampling reorders or interpolates channels without a mapping receipt.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject chainage/route results; preserve source axis and transform lineage.

scenarios.name: Missing time samples are interpolated as continuous data
scenarios.conditions: Acquisition has a real clock/sample gap.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Keep explicit gap; no event-negative claim across missing samples.

scenarios.name: Denoiser evaluated on a new site/corridor
scenarios.conditions: Site, day and event sessions are held out from training and tuning.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report transfer, calibration, abstention and performance delta without target fine-tuning.

scenarios.name: Denoising occurs after lossy compression
scenarios.conditions: Compression distortion and denoising interact, source is separately retained.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Evaluate both transforms and combined chain against raw reference; record both digests.

scenarios.name: Enhanced signal produces overconfident position intervals
scenarios.conditions: Held-out surveyed truth falls outside the nominal interval too often.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Fail uncertainty coverage regardless of average error or image quality.

scenarios.name: Candidate preserves critical event POD
scenarios.conditions: Same event population and truth; pre-registered non-inferiority margin.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Accept only if confidence interval satisfies the frozen margin.

scenarios.name: Adjacent overlapping windows split across train/test
scenarios.conditions: Same acquisition/event appears on both sides of the split.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject headline result; regroup by source event/session/site.

scenarios.name: Denoiser improves image quality but misses latency/compute budget
scenarios.conditions: Inference exceeds the declared resource/latency envelope.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject deployment suitability; report compute/energy per fibre-km-day.

global_controls: Raw source artifacts are immutable and replayable.
Every denoised artifact binds parent digest, algorithm/method revision and parameter digest.
PSNR, SSIM and SNR are supplemental and cannot substitute for event POD/localization.
Overlapping windows and augmentations from one source event remain in one split.
Every event class/magnitude and no-event background is reported separately.
Unknown or degraded observability is not a clean negative observation.
Geographic route error is evaluated only after independent route calibration.
Signal timing and spatial/channel alignment changes require explicit transformation receipts.
Cross-site transfer requires held-out sites/campaigns without hidden target adaptation.
Compression and denoising transforms are tested separately and jointly against raw source.
